recent_trades.summary: Initiating a 5% long position in Intel as reports highlight the enduring relevance of CPUs in emerging Agentic AI workloads.

The recent warning on Project Jupiter threatening its 2028 targets represents a fundamental impairment of this bull thesis, suggesting the stock has further to fall as analysts revise models.

I already reduced the position twice today, leaving only a small residual weight; fully exiting simplifies the healthcare sleeve and reallocates away from the least-supported thesis without materially changing overall portfolio risk. Compared with LLY, TMO, JNJ, and even ABBV, ABT currently has the least compelling catalyst support.

recent_trades.summary: Add again to SLB as fresh Aramco contract wins strengthen the specific Middle East growth catalyst already developing.

recent_trades.summary: Add to SLB on fresh multi-year Aramco contract wins and continued positive Middle East growth news.

The stock is near its 30-day high but not extended, and energy is holding up better than much of the market. Increasing only to 3% respects that this is still a cyclical services name while aligning size with improved news quality.
